    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="en">
    <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Times Tables Practice</title>
    <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    color: #e8f0fe;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 20px 16px 60px;
    }
    #app { width: 100%; max-width: 600px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .screen { display: none; }
    .screen.active { display: block; }
    .card { background: #16213e; border-radius: 18px; padding: 30px 26px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
    h1 { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 900; text-align: center; color: #ffd166; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .subtitle { text-align: center; color: #7a8fb5; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    label { display: block; font-weight: 700; color: #7a8fb5; font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 7px; }
    input[type="text"], input[type="number"] {
    width: 100%; background: #0f3460; border: 2px solid #0f3460; border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 12px 15px; font-size: 1.05rem; font-family: inherit; color: #e8f0fe;
    outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; font-weight: 700;
    }
    input:focus { border-color: #ffd166; }
    .btn {
    display: block; width: 100%; padding: 13px; border-radius: 10px;
    font-family: inherit; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer;
    border: none; transition: transform 0.1s, filter 0.15s; margin-top: 12px; text-align: center;
    }
    .btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }
    .btn-yellow { background: #ffd166; color: #1a1a2e; }
    .btn-red { background: #ef476f; color: #fff; }
    .btn-teal { background: #06d6a0; color: #1a1a2e; }
    .btn-blue { background: #118ab2; color: #fff; }
    .btn-gray { background: #0f3460; color: #e8f0fe; }
    .btn-purple { background: #7b5ea7; color: #fff; }
    .btn-small { padding: 9px; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 10px; }
    .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.38; pointer-events: none; }
    .welcome-box { background: #0f3460; border: 1px solid #06d6a0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 15px; margin-bottom: 18px; display: none; }
    .welcome-box.show { display: block; }
    .welcome-name { font-weight: 800; color: #06d6a0; font-size: 0.98rem; }
    .welcome-stats { color: #7a8fb5; font-size: 0.82rem; margin-top: 3px; }
    .mode-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin: 14px 0; }
    .mode-btn {
    background: #0f3460; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 10px;
    cursor: pointer; text-align: center; color: #e8f0fe; transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .mode-btn:hover { border-color: #ffd166; transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .mode-btn.selected { border-color: #ffd166; background: rgba(255,209,102,0.1); }
    .mode-time { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ffd166; }
    .mode-label { font-size: 0.82rem; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 3px; }
    .mode-count { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7a8fb5; margin-top: 2px; }
    .link-row { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; margin-top: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .link-btn { background: none; border: none; color: #7a8fb5; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px; transition: color 0.2s; }
    .link-btn:hover { color: #e8f0fe; }
    .section-box { background: #0f3460; border-radius: 10px; padding: 13px 15px; margin-top: 14px; }
    .section-box h3 { font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #7a8fb5; margin-bottom: 9px; font-weight: 700; }
    .hist-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-size: 0.86rem; }
    .hist-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .hist-score { font-weight: 800; color: #06d6a0; }
    .hist-date { color: #7a8fb5; font-size: 0.76rem; }
    /* ── WHAT SHOULD I PRACTICE box ── */
    .wsip-box {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(123,94,167,0.2), rgba(17,138,178,0.15));
    border: 1px solid rgba(123,94,167,0.4);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
    margin-top: 14px;
    }
    .wsip-title { font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #b89fd4; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .wsip-facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .wsip-tag {
    background: rgba(239,71,111,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(239,71,111,0.4);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #ef476f;
    }
    .wsip-tag span { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 600; margin-left: 4px; }
    .wsip-prompt { font-size: 0.88rem; color: #b89fd4; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .wsip-modes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
    .wsip-mode-btn {
    background: rgba(123,94,167,0.25); border: 1px solid rgba(123,94,167,0.4);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 4px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit; color: #e8f0fe; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .wsip-mode-btn:hover { background: rgba(123,94,167,0.5); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .wsip-mode-time { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ffd166; }
    .wsip-mode-label { font-size: 0.65rem; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; }
    /* ── QUIZ ── */
    .quiz-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .stat-box { flex: 1; background: #0f3460; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 5px; text-align: center; }
    .stat-val { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ffd166; line-height: 1.1; }
    .stat-lbl { font-size: 0.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 1px; }
    .timer-bar-wrap { width: 100%; height: 7px; background: #0f3460; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 16px; overflow: hidden; }
    .timer-bar { height: 100%; background: #06d6a0; border-radius: 4px; transition: width 0.9s linear, background 0.5s; }
    .timer-bar.warn { background: #ffd166; }
    .timer-bar.danger { background: #ef476f; }
    .focus-badge { background: rgba(123,94,167,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(123,94,167,0.5); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; color: #b89fd4; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 12px; display: none; }
    .focus-badge.show { display: block; }
    .progress-dots { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 14px; justify-content: center; min-height: 12px; }
    .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0f3460; transition: background 0.2s; }
    .dot.c { background: #06d6a0; }
    .dot.cur { background: #ffd166; animation: dpulse 0.7s ease infinite; }
    @keyframes dpulse { 0%,100%{transform:scale(1);} 50%{transform:scale(1.6);} }
    .problem-display { text-align: center; font-size: 3.8rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 3px; margin: 8px 0 20px; color: #e8f0fe; }
    .problem-display .op { color: #118ab2; }
    .problem-display .eq { color: #7a8fb5; }
    #answerInput { font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 900; text-align: center; padding: 13px; border-radius: 12px; border-width: 3px; }
    #answerInput.correct { border-color: #06d6a0; background: rgba(6,214,160,0.1); }
    #answerInput.wrong { border-color: #ef476f; background: rgba(239,71,111,0.1); animation: shake 0.3s; }
    @keyframes shake { 0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);} 25%{transform:translateX(-6px);} 75%{transform:translateX(6px);} }
    /* ── RESULTS ── */
    .result-hero { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .result-emoji { font-size: 3rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .result-title { font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ffd166; }
    .result-sub { color: #7a8fb5; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 3px; }
    .stats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .stat-card { background: #0f3460; border-radius: 10px; padding: 13px 7px; text-align: center; }
    .sc-val { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ffd166; }
    .sc-lbl { font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; }
    .slow-title { font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 700; margin: 14px 0 6px; }
    .tag-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
    .slow-tag { background: rgba(239,71,111,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(239,71,111,0.35); border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #ef476f; }
    .slow-tag span { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 600; margin-left: 3px; }
    .good-tag { background: rgba(6,214,160,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,160,0.3); border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #06d6a0; }
    .good-tag span { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 600; margin-left: 3px; }
    .btn-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; }
    .btn-row .btn { margin-top: 0; }
    /* ── INFO SCREEN ── */
    .back-link { background: none; border: none; color: #7a8fb5; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 0 14px; display: block; transition: color 0.2s; }
    .back-link:hover { color: #e8f0fe; }
    .screen-title { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .screen-sub { color: #7a8fb5; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .tab {
    flex: 1; min-width: 60px; padding: 8px 4px; background: #0f3460; border: 2px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 9px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; color: #7a8fb5;
    cursor: pointer; text-align: center; transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .tab:hover { color: #e8f0fe; }
    .tab.active { border-color: #ffd166; color: #ffd166; background: rgba(255,209,102,0.08); }
    .tab-panel { display: none; }
    .tab-panel.active { display: block; }
    .info-section { margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .info-section-title { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #7a8fb5; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); }
    .summary-pills { display: flex; gap: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .pill-gold { background: rgba(255,209,102,0.15); color: #ffd166; border: 1px solid rgba(255,209,102,0.3); }
    .pill-teal { background: rgba(6,214,160,0.12); color: #06d6a0; border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,160,0.25); }
    /* ── FACT MAP: simple list layout ── */
    .fact-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
    .fact-row {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px;
    border-radius: 8px; background: #0f3460;
    }
    .fact-row-label { font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.88rem; min-width: 60px; color: #e8f0fe; }
    .fact-row-bar-wrap { flex: 1; height: 8px; background: #1a1a2e; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
    .fact-row-bar { height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; transition: width 0.3s; }
    .fact-row-time { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; min-width: 42px; text-align: right; }
    .fact-row-count { font-size: 0.7rem; color: #7a8fb5; min-width: 28px; text-align: right; }
    .fact-row.unseen .fact-row-label { color: #3a4f6b; }
    .fact-row.unseen .fact-row-time { color: #3a4f6b; }
    /* ── TOP 10 ── */
    .fact-top10-block { margin-bottom: 14px; background: #0f3460; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; }
    .fact-top10-title { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 900; color: #e8f0fe; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .t10-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 3px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); font-size: 0.82rem; }
    .t10-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .t10-rank { min-width: 22px; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 700; }
    .t10-bar-wrap { flex: 1; height: 5px; background: #1a1a2e; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; }
    .t10-bar { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; }
    .t10-time { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 800; min-width: 38px; text-align: right; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.85rem; }
    th { text-align: left; color: #7a8fb5; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; padding: 5px 9px; font-weight: 700; }
    td { padding: 8px 9px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-weight: 600; }
    tr:hover td { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
    .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .badge-gold { background: rgba(255,209,102,0.2); color: #ffd166; }
    .badge-green { background: rgba(6,214,160,0.2); color: #06d6a0; }
    .badge-red { background: rgba(239,71,111,0.2); color: #ef476f; }
    .empty { text-align: center; padding: 28px; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 600; }
    /* ── PROGRESS GRAPH ── */
    .graph-screen { display: none; }
    .graph-screen.active { display: block; }
    .fact-selector-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr); gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .fact-sel-btn {
    background: #0f3460; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 4px;
    font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; color: #7a8fb5;
    cursor: pointer; text-align: center; transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .fact-sel-btn:hover { border-color: #ffd166; color: #e8f0fe; }
    .fact-sel-btn.active { border-color: #ffd166; background: rgba(255,209,102,0.12); color: #ffd166; }
    .fact-sel-btn.has-data { color: #e8f0fe; }
    .fact-sel-btn.no-data { opacity: 0.4; }
    .graph-wrap { background: #0f3460; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .graph-title { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; color: #7a8fb5; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .graph-svg { width: 100%; display: block; }
    .graph-empty { text-align:center; padding: 40px 0; color: #7a8fb5; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .graph-stats { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; }
    .graph-stat { background: #16213e; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; }
    .graph-stat span { display: block; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ffd166; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .graph-stat label { font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #7a8fb5; }
    .confetti-piece { position: fixed; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: cfall 2.5s ease forwards; }
    @keyframes cfall { 0%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;} 100%{transform:translateY(105vh) rotate(720deg);opacity:0;} }
    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
    <div id="app">
    <!-- ══ LOGIN ══ -->
    <div id="loginScreen" class="screen active">
    <div class="card">
    <h1>&#11088; Times Tables</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Multiplication Practice &middot; Grade 4</p>
    <div id="welcomeBox" class="welcome-box">
    <div class="welcome-name" id="wbName"></div>
    <div class="welcome-stats" id="wbStats"></div>
    </div>
    <label for="nameInput">What's your name?</label>
    <input type="text" id="nameInput" placeholder="Type your name here..." maxlength="30" autocomplete="off">
    <button class="btn btn-yellow" id="loginBtn">Let's Go! &#x1F680;</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ MODE SELECT ══ -->
    <div id="modeScreen" class="screen">
    <div class="card">
    <h1 style="font-size:1.4rem;text-align:left;margin-bottom:2px;" id="modeGreeting">Hi!</h1>
    <p class="subtitle" style="text-align:left;margin-bottom:14px;">Choose how long to practice:</p>
    <div class="mode-grid">
    <button class="mode-btn" id="mode-30">
    <div class="mode-time">0:30</div><div class="mode-label">Quick Burst</div><div class="mode-count">~10 problems</div>
    </button>
    <button class="mode-btn" id="mode-60">
    <div class="mode-time">1:00</div><div class="mode-label">Speed Round</div><div class="mode-count">~20 problems</div>
    </button>
    <button class="mode-btn" id="mode-120">
    <div class="mode-time">2:00</div><div class="mode-label">Challenge</div><div class="mode-count">~40 problems</div>
    </button>
    <button class="mode-btn" id="mode-300">
    <div class="mode-time">5:00</div><div class="mode-label">Full Test</div><div class="mode-count">100 problems</div>
    </button>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-yellow" id="startBtn" disabled>Start Practice &#x26A1;</button>
    <div id="histMini"></div>
    <!-- What Should I Practice -->
    <div id="wsipBox" class="wsip-box" style="display:none;">
    <div class="wsip-title">&#x1F3AF; What Should I Practice?</div>
    <div class="wsip-facts" id="wsipFacts"></div>
    <div class="wsip-prompt">Practice just these facts &mdash; pick a time:</div>
    <div class="wsip-modes">
    <button class="wsip-mode-btn" id="wsip-30">
    <div class="wsip-mode-time">0:30</div><div class="wsip-mode-label">Quick</div>
    </button>
    <button class="wsip-mode-btn" id="wsip-60">
    <div class="wsip-mode-time">1:00</div><div class="wsip-mode-label">Speed</div>
    </button>
    <button class="wsip-mode-btn" id="wsip-120">
    <div class="wsip-mode-time">2:00</div><div class="wsip-mode-label">Challenge</div>
    </button>
    <button class="wsip-mode-btn" id="wsip-300">
    <div class="wsip-mode-time">5:00</div><div class="wsip-mode-label">Full</div>
    </button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="link-row">
    <button class="link-btn" id="switchPlayerBtn">&larr; Switch Player</button>
    <button class="link-btn" id="myInfoBtnMode">&#x1F4CA; My Info</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ QUIZ ══ -->
    <div id="quizScreen" class="screen">
    <div class="card">
    <div class="quiz-header">
    <div class="stat-box"><div class="stat-val" id="timerDisp">5:00</div><div class="stat-lbl">Time</div></div>
    <div class="stat-box"><div class="stat-val" id="scoreDisp">0</div><div class="stat-lbl">Correct</div></div>
    <div class="stat-box"><div class="stat-val" id="totalDisp">0</div><div class="stat-lbl">Done</div></div>
    <div class="stat-box"><div class="stat-val" id="streakDisp">0&#x1F525;</div><div class="stat-lbl">Streak</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="timer-bar-wrap"><div class="timer-bar" id="timerBar" style="width:100%;"></div></div>
    <div class="focus-badge" id="focusBadge"></div>
    <div class="progress-dots" id="progressDots"></div>
    <div class="problem-display">
    <span id="numA">6</span><span class="op"> &times; </span><span id="numB">7</span><span class="eq"> = </span>
    </div>
    <input type="number" id="answerInput" placeholder="?" min="0" max="999" autocomplete="off">
    <button class="btn btn-red btn-small" id="endEarlyBtn">&#9209; End Test Early</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ RESULTS ══ -->
    <div id="resultsScreen" class="screen">
    <div class="card">
    <div class="result-hero">
    <span class="result-emoji" id="resEmoji">&#x1F389;</span>
    <div class="result-title" id="resTitle">Amazing!</div>
    <div class="result-sub" id="resSub"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stats-grid">
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="sc-val" id="resScore">0</div><div class="sc-lbl">Correct</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="sc-val" id="resAcc">0%</div><div class="sc-lbl">Accuracy</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="sc-val" id="resAvg">--</div><div class="sc-lbl">Avg Speed</div></div>
    </div>
    <div id="slowSection" style="display:none;">
    <div class="slow-title">&#x1F422; Needs Work (slowest this session)</div>
    <div class="tag-grid" id="slowGrid"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="wrongSection" style="display:none;margin-top:4px;">
    <div class="slow-title">&#x274C; Most Wrong This Session</div>
    <div class="tag-grid" id="wrongGrid"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="fastSection" style="display:none;margin-top:4px;">
    <div class="slow-title">&#x26A1; Fastest This Session</div>
    <div class="tag-grid" id="fastGrid"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-gray" id="resMyInfoBtn">&#x1F4CA; My Info</button>
    <button class="btn btn-yellow" id="resPlayAgainBtn">Play Again &#x1F680;</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ MY INFO ══ -->
    <div id="infoScreen" class="screen">
    <div class="card">
    <button class="back-link" id="infoBackBtn">&larr; Back</button>
    <div class="screen-title" id="infoTitle">My Info</div>
    <div class="screen-sub" id="infoSub"></div>
    <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" id="tab-overview" onclick="switchTab('overview')">Overview</button>
    <button class="tab" id="tab-factmap" onclick="switchTab('factmap')">Fact Map</button>
    <button class="tab" id="tab-top10" onclick="switchTab('top10')">Top 10</button>
    <button class="tab" id="tab-graphs" onclick="switchTab('graphs')">Graphs</button>
    <button class="tab" id="tab-history" onclick="switchTab('history')">History</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-panel active" id="panel-overview">
    <div class="info-section">
    <div class="info-section-title">&#x1F3C6; You're Great At</div>
    <div class="tag-grid" id="bestFacts"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="info-section">
    <div class="info-section-title">&#x1F3AF; Keep Practicing (slowest avg)</div>
    <div class="tag-grid" id="weakFacts"></div>
    <button class="btn btn-purple btn-small" id="practiceWorst4Btn" style="display:none;margin-top:10px;">&#x1F3AF; Practice My Worst 4 Facts</button>
    </div>
    <div class="info-section">
    <div class="info-section-title">&#x274C; Most Frequently Wrong</div>
    <div class="tag-grid" id="wrongFacts"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="info-section">
    <div class="info-section-title">&#x1F4CA; Overall Stats</div>
    <div class="summary-pills" id="overallStats"></div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-factmap">
    <p style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#7a8fb5;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:600;">Every fact with your average time. Sorted slowest first so you can see what to work on.</p>
    <div id="factMapContent"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-top10">
    <p style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#7a8fb5;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:600;">Your 10 best (fastest correct) times ever recorded for each fact.</p>
    <div id="top10Content"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-graphs">
    <p style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#7a8fb5;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:600;">Choose any fact to see a graph of how your speed has improved over time.</p>
    <div class="fact-selector-grid" id="graphFactGrid"></div>
    <div id="graphDisplay"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-history">
    <div id="histTableContent"></div>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div><!-- #app -->
    <script>
    (function(){
    'use strict';
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // DATA
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    function getData(){ try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tt_v3')||'{}'); }catch(e){ return {}; } }
    function saveData(d){ localStorage.setItem('tt_v3', JSON.stringify(d)); }
    function getUser(name){ return getData()[name.trim().toLowerCase()]||null; }
    function initUser(name){
    var d=getData(), k=name.trim().toLowerCase();
    if(!d[k]) d[k]={ displayName:name.trim(), sessions:[], facts:{} };
    else{ d[k].displayName=name.trim(); if(!d[k].facts) d[k].facts={}; }
    saveData(d); return d[k];
    }
    // facts[key] = { totalMs, count, wrongCount, best10:[] sorted asc, history:[{t,ms}] }
    function recordFact(d, ukey, fk, ms, isWrong){
    if(!d[ukey].facts[fk]) d[ukey].facts[fk]={ totalMs:0, count:0, wrongCount:0, best10:[], history:[] };
    var f=d[ukey].facts[fk];
    if(!f.history) f.history=[];
    f.totalMs+=ms; f.count++;
    if(isWrong){
    f.wrongCount=(f.wrongCount||0)+1;
    } else {
    // Store correct attempt in history (cap at 200 entries per fact)
    f.history.push({ t:Date.now(), ms:ms });
    if(f.history.length>200) f.history=f.history.slice(-200);
    f.best10.push(ms);
    f.best10.sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
    if(f.best10.length>10) f.best10=f.best10.slice(0,10);
    }
    }
    function saveSession(ukey, session){
    var d=getData();
    if(!d[ukey]) return;
    // store slim session (no times array — facts already updated)
    d[ukey].sessions.push({ date:session.date, dur:session.dur, correct:session.correct, total:session.total, avgMs:session.avgMs });
    // update per-fact records from every answered question
    session.times.forEach(function(t){ recordFact(d, ukey, t.p, t.ms, !t.ok); });
    saveData(d);
    }
    function fmtMs(ms){
    if(ms===undefined||ms===null) return '--';
    return (ms/1000).toFixed(2)+'s';
    }
    function fmtMsShort(ms){ return (ms/1000).toFixed(1)+'s'; }
    function fmtTime(s){ if(s>=300) return '5 min'; if(s>=120) return '2 min'; if(s>=60) return '1 min'; return '30 sec'; }
    function fmtDate(iso){ return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'}); }
    function fkey(a,b){ return a+'x'+b; }
    function flabel(k){ return k.replace('x','\u00D7'); }
    // All 64 facts 2-9
    var ALL_FACTS=(function(){
    var r=[];
    for(var a=2;a<=9;a++) for(var b=2;b<=9;b++) r.push([a,b]);
    return r;
    })();
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // STATE
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    var user=null, userKey=null, selMode=null;
    var focusFacts=null; // null = all facts, array of [a,b] = focus mode
    var problems=[], qIdx=0, qCorrect=0, qTotal=0, qStreak=0;
    var timeLeft=0, totalTime=0, timer=null;
    var qTimes=[], qStart=0;
    var prevScreen='modeScreen';
    var currentTab='overview';
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // SCREEN HELPER
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    function show(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(function(s){ s.classList.remove('active'); });
    document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
    }
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // LOGIN
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    var nameInput=document.getElementById('nameInput');
    nameInput.addEventListener('input',function(){
    var n=this.value.trim(), wb=document.getElementById('welcomeBox');
    if(n.length>1){
    var ud=getUser(n);
    if(ud&&ud.sessions&&ud.sessions.length>0){
    wb.classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('wbName').textContent='Welcome back, '+ud.displayName+'!';
    var last=ud.sessions[ud.sessions.length-1];
    var best=ud.sessions.reduce(function(b,s){ return s.correct>(b?b.correct:-1)?s:b; },null);
    document.getElementById('wbStats').textContent=
    ud.sessions.length+' sessions \u00b7 Last: '+last.correct+'/'+last.total+' \u00b7 Best: '+best.correct+'/'+best.total;
    } else wb.classList.remove('show');
    } else wb.classList.remove('show');
    });
    nameInput.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter') handleLogin(); });
    document.getElementById('loginBtn').addEventListener('click', handleLogin);
    function handleLogin(){
    var name=nameInput.value.trim();
    if(!name){ nameInput.focus(); nameInput.style.borderColor='#ef476f'; setTimeout(function(){ nameInput.style.borderColor=''; },1000); return; }
    userKey=name.toLowerCase();
    user=initUser(name);
    document.getElementById('modeGreeting').textContent='Hi, '+user.displayName+'! \uD83D\uDC4B';
    selMode=null; focusFacts=null;
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('selected'); });
    document.getElementById('startBtn').disabled=true;
    renderModeScreen();
    show('modeScreen');
    }
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // MODE SCREEN
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    [30,60,120,300].forEach(function(s){
    document.getElementById('mode-'+s).addEventListener('click',function(){ selectMode(s); });
    });
    document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){ startQuiz(false); });
    document.getElementById('switchPlayerBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){ show('loginScreen'); });
    document.getElementById('myInfoBtnMode').addEventListener('click',function(){ showInfo('overview'); });
    // WSIP mode buttons
    [30,60,120,300].forEach(function(s){
    document.getElementById('wsip-'+s).addEventListener('click',function(){ startQuiz(true, s); });
    });
    function selectMode(s){
    selMode=s;
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('selected'); });
    document.getElementById('mode-'+s).classList.add('selected');
    document.getElementById('startBtn').disabled=false;
    }
    function renderModeScreen(){
    renderHistMini();
    renderWSIP();
    }
    function renderHistMini(){
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey], hm=document.getElementById('histMini');
    if(!ud||!ud.sessions||!ud.sessions.length){ hm.innerHTML=''; return; }
    var recent=ud.sessions.slice().reverse().slice(0,4);
    hm.innerHTML='<div class="section-box"><h3>Recent Sessions</h3>'+
    recent.map(function(s){
    var acc=s.total>0?Math.round(s.correct/s.total*100):0;
    return '<div class="hist-row"><span>'+fmtTime(s.dur)+'</span><span class="hist-score">'+s.correct+'/'+s.total+' ('+acc+'%)</span><span class="hist-date">'+fmtDate(s.date)+'</span></div>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
    }
    function renderWSIP(){
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey], box=document.getElementById('wsipBox');
    if(!ud||!ud.facts){ box.style.display='none'; return; }
    // Find top 4 slowest facts with at least 2 attempts
    var entries=ALL_FACTS
    .map(function(ab){
    var k=fkey(ab[0],ab[1]), f=ud.facts[k];
    return f&&f.count>=2 ? { ab:ab, avg:f.totalMs/f.count } : null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort(function(a,b){ return b.avg-a.avg; })
    .slice(0,4);
    if(!entries.length){ box.style.display='none'; return; }
    box.style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('wsipFacts').innerHTML=entries.map(function(e){
    return '<div class="wsip-tag">'+e.ab[0]+'\u00D7'+e.ab[1]+'<span>avg '+fmtMsShort(e.avg)+'</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    // store for use when launching
    window._wsipFacts=entries.map(function(e){ return e.ab; });
    }
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // PROBLEM GENERATION
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    function genProblems(n, restrictFacts){
    var source = restrictFacts || ALL_FACTS;
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey], facts=ud&&ud.facts?ud.facts:{};
    var pool=[];
    source.forEach(function(ab){
    var k=fkey(ab[0],ab[1]), f=facts[k];
    var w=1;
    if(f&&f.count>0){
    var avg=f.totalMs/f.count;
    if(avg>6000) w=5; else if(avg>4000) w=4; else if(avg>3000) w=3; else if(avg>2000) w=2;
    } else w=2;
    for(var i=0;i<w;i++) pool.push(ab);
    });
    pool.sort(function(){ return Math.random()-0.5; });
    var result=[];
    for(var j=0;j<n;j++) result.push(pool[j%pool.length]);
    return result;
    }
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // QUIZ
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    function startQuiz(isFocus, forceDur){
    var dur = isFocus ? forceDur : selMode;
    if(!dur) return;
    var restrict = isFocus ? window._wsipFacts : null;
    var n = dur===300 ? 100 : Math.max(10, Math.floor(dur/3));
    focusFacts = restrict;
    problems=genProblems(n, restrict);
    qIdx=0; qCorrect=0; qTotal=0; qStreak=0; qTimes=[];
    timeLeft=dur; totalTime=dur;
    // Focus badge
    var fb=document.getElementById('focusBadge');
    if(restrict&&restrict.length){
    fb.textContent='\uD83C\uDFAF Focus mode: '+restrict.map(function(ab){ return ab[0]+'\u00D7'+ab[1]; }).join(', ');
    fb.classList.add('show');
    } else { fb.classList.remove('show'); }
    // Dots
    var dots=document.getElementById('progressDots'); dots.innerHTML='';
    var showN=Math.min(n,50);
    for(var i=0;i<showN;i++){
    var dot=document.createElement('div');
    dot.className='dot'+(i===0?' cur':'');
    dot.id='dot'+i; dots.appendChild(dot);
    }
    updateStats(); updateTimerDisplay(); showProblem();
    show('quizScreen');
    var inp=document.getElementById('answerInput');
    inp.value=''; inp.className='';
    setTimeout(function(){ inp.focus(); },100);
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer=setInterval(function(){ timeLeft--; updateTimerDisplay(); if(timeLeft<=0) endQuiz(); },1000);
    }
    function showProblem(){
    if(qIdx>=problems.length){ endQuiz(); return; }
    answerLocked=false;
    var ab=problems[qIdx];
    document.getElementById('numA').textContent=ab[0];
    document.getElementById('numB').textContent=ab[1];
    qStart=Date.now();
    var inp=document.getElementById('answerInput');
    inp.value=''; inp.className='';
    }
    var answerLocked=false;
    function submitAnswer(){
    if(answerLocked) return;
    var inp=document.getElementById('answerInput');
    var raw=inp.value.trim();
    var val=parseInt(raw,10);
    if(isNaN(val)) return;
    var ab=problems[qIdx];
    var ms=Date.now()-qStart;
    if(val===ab[0]*ab[1]){
    qTimes.push({ p:fkey(ab[0],ab[1]), ms:ms, ok:true });
    inp.className='correct';
    qCorrect++; qTotal++; qStreak++;
    updateStats();
    var pd=document.getElementById('dot'+qIdx); if(pd) pd.className='dot c';
    qIdx++;
    var nd=document.getElementById('dot'+qIdx); if(nd) nd.className='dot cur';
    setTimeout(function(){ showProblem(); inp.focus(); },200);
    } else {
    qTimes.push({ p:fkey(ab[0],ab[1]), ms:ms, ok:false });
    qStreak=0;
    updateStats();
    answerLocked=true;
    // Force re-trigger shake by removing then re-adding class
    inp.className='';
    void inp.offsetWidth; // reflow
    inp.className='wrong';
    setTimeout(function(){
    inp.value='';
    inp.className='';
    answerLocked=false;
    inp.focus();
    qStart=Date.now();
    },500);
    }
    }
    // Auto-advance when correct answer is typed (no Enter needed)
    document.getElementById('answerInput').addEventListener('input',function(){
    if(answerLocked) return;
    var val=parseInt(this.value,10);
    if(isNaN(val)) return;
    var ab=problems[qIdx];
    if(val===ab[0]*ab[1]) submitAnswer();
    });
    // Enter key triggers wrong-answer check
    document.getElementById('answerInput').addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Enter'){
    e.preventDefault();
    submitAnswer();
    }
    });
    document.getElementById('endEarlyBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(confirm('Are you sure you want to end the test early?')) endQuiz();
    else document.getElementById('answerInput').focus();
    });
    function updateStats(){
    document.getElementById('scoreDisp').textContent=qCorrect;
    document.getElementById('totalDisp').textContent=qTotal;
    document.getElementById('streakDisp').textContent=qStreak+'\uD83D\uDD25';
    }
    function updateTimerDisplay(){
    var m=Math.floor(timeLeft/60), s=timeLeft%60;
    document.getElementById('timerDisp').textContent=m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;
    var pct=(timeLeft/totalTime)*100;
    var bar=document.getElementById('timerBar');
    bar.style.width=pct+'%';
    bar.className='timer-bar'+(pct<15?' danger':pct<30?' warn':'');
    }
    function endQuiz(){
    clearInterval(timer);
    var avgMs=qTimes.length>0?Math.round(qTimes.reduce(function(t,q){ return t+q.ms; },0)/qTimes.length):0;
    var session={ date:new Date().toISOString(), dur:totalTime, correct:qCorrect, total:qTotal, avgMs:avgMs, times:qTimes };
    saveSession(userKey, session);
    showResults(session);
    }
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // RESULTS
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    document.getElementById('resMyInfoBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){ showInfo('overview'); });
    document.getElementById('resPlayAgainBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){ renderModeScreen(); show('modeScreen'); });
    function showResults(s){
    show('resultsScreen');
    var acc=s.total>0?Math.round(s.correct/s.total*100):0;
    var emoji,title;
    if(acc>=95){ emoji='\uD83C\uDFC6'; title='Superstar!'; doConfetti(); }
    else if(acc>=85){ emoji='\uD83C\uDF1F'; title='Awesome!'; }
    else if(acc>=70){ emoji='\uD83D\uDC4D'; title='Good Job!'; }
    else{ emoji='\uD83D\uDCAA'; title='Keep Going!'; }
    document.getElementById('resEmoji').textContent=emoji;
    document.getElementById('resTitle').textContent=title;
    document.getElementById('resSub').textContent=s.correct+' correct out of '+s.total+' answered';
    document.getElementById('resScore').textContent=s.correct+'/'+s.total;
    document.getElementById('resAcc').textContent=acc+'%';
    document.getElementById('resAvg').textContent=s.avgMs>0?fmtMs(s.avgMs):'--';
    // Build per-fact summary for this session
    var factMap={};
    s.times.forEach(function(t){
    if(!factMap[t.p]) factMap[t.p]={ slowest:0, fastest:Infinity, wrongCount:0 };
    if(t.ms>factMap[t.p].slowest) factMap[t.p].slowest=t.ms;
    if(t.ms<factMap[t.p].fastest) factMap[t.p].fastest=t.ms;
    if(!t.ok) factMap[t.p].wrongCount++;
    });
    var slowEntries=Object.keys(factMap).filter(function(k){ return factMap[k].slowest>4000; })
    .sort(function(a,b){ return factMap[b].slowest-factMap[a].slowest; }).slice(0,8);
    var slowSec=document.getElementById('slowSection');
    if(slowEntries.length){
    slowSec.style.display='';
    document.getElementById('slowGrid').innerHTML=slowEntries.map(function(k){
    return '<div class="slow-tag">'+flabel(k)+'<span>'+fmtMsShort(factMap[k].slowest)+'</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    } else slowSec.style.display='none';
    // Wrong answers this session
    var wrongEntries=Object.keys(factMap).filter(function(k){ return factMap[k].wrongCount>0; })
    .sort(function(a,b){ return factMap[b].wrongCount-factMap[a].wrongCount; }).slice(0,8);
    var wrongSec=document.getElementById('wrongSection');
    if(wrongEntries.length){
    wrongSec.style.display='';
    document.getElementById('wrongGrid').innerHTML=wrongEntries.map(function(k){
    return '<div class="slow-tag">'+flabel(k)+'<span>'+factMap[k].wrongCount+' wrong</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    } else wrongSec.style.display='none';
    var fastEntries=Object.keys(factMap).filter(function(k){ return factMap[k].fastest<2000; })
    .sort(function(a,b){ return factMap[a].fastest-factMap[b].fastest; }).slice(0,6);
    var fastSec=document.getElementById('fastSection');
    if(fastEntries.length){
    fastSec.style.display='';
    document.getElementById('fastGrid').innerHTML=fastEntries.map(function(k){
    return '<div class="good-tag">'+flabel(k)+'<span>'+fmtMsShort(factMap[k].fastest)+'</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    } else fastSec.style.display='none';
    }
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    // MY INFO SCREEN
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════
    function showInfo(tabName){
    prevScreen=document.querySelector('.screen.active')?document.querySelector('.screen.active').id:'modeScreen';
    show('infoScreen');
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey];
    document.getElementById('infoTitle').textContent=(ud?ud.displayName:'')+'\u2019s Info';
    var ns=ud&&ud.sessions?ud.sessions.length:0;
    var na=ud&&ud.sessions?ud.sessions.reduce(function(t,s){ return t+s.total; },0):0;
    document.getElementById('infoSub').textContent=ns+' sessions \u00b7 '+na+' problems answered';
    switchTab(tabName||'overview');
    }
    document.getElementById('infoBackBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
    show(prevScreen||'modeScreen');
    if(prevScreen==='modeScreen') renderModeScreen();
    });
    function switchTab(name){
    currentTab=name;
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(t){ t.classList.remove('active'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('active'); });
    document.getElementById('tab-'+name).classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('panel-'+name).classList.add('active');
    if(name==='overview') renderOverview();
    if(name==='factmap') renderFactMap();
    if(name==='top10') renderTop10();
    if(name==='graphs') renderGraphs(null);
    if(name==='history') renderHistory();
    }
    window.switchTab=switchTab;
    // ── Practice Worst 4 from My Info ───────
    document.getElementById('practiceWorst4Btn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(!window._worst4Facts || !window._worst4Facts.length) return;
    // Set wsip to the worst 4 facts and navigate to mode screen
    window._wsipFacts = window._worst4Facts;
    prevScreen = 'modeScreen';
    show('modeScreen');
    renderHistMini();
    // Manually populate the wsip box
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey];
    var box=document.getElementById('wsipBox');
    box.style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('wsipFacts').innerHTML=window._worst4Facts.map(function(ab){
    var k=fkey(ab[0],ab[1]), f=ud&&ud.facts?ud.facts[k]:null;
    var avg=f&&f.count>0?(f.totalMs/f.count):0;
    return '<div class="wsip-tag">'+ab[0]+'\u00D7'+ab[1]+(avg?'<span>avg '+fmtMsShort(avg)+'</span>':'')+'</div>';
    }).join('');
    });
    // ── Overview ────────────────────────────
    function renderOverview(){
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey];
    if(!ud){ return; }
    var facts=ud.facts||{};
    var practiced=ALL_FACTS
    .map(function(ab){ var k=fkey(ab[0],ab[1]),f=facts[k]; return f&&f.count>=2?{ k:k, avg:f.totalMs/f.count, wrongCount:f.wrongCount||0 }:null; })
    .filter(Boolean);
    practiced.sort(function(a,b){ return a.avg-b.avg; });
    var best=practiced.slice(0,8), weak=practiced.slice().reverse().slice(0,8);
    // Most wrong: sort by wrongCount desc, min 1 wrong
    var mostWrong=ALL_FACTS
    .map(function(ab){ var k=fkey(ab[0],ab[1]),f=facts[k]; return f&&(f.wrongCount||0)>=1?{ k:k, wrongCount:f.wrongCount||0, count:f.count }:null; })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort(function(a,b){ return b.wrongCount-a.wrongCount; })
    .slice(0,8);
    var bestEl=document.getElementById('bestFacts'), weakEl=document.getElementById('weakFacts'), wrongEl=document.getElementById('wrongFacts');
    bestEl.innerHTML=best.length
    ? best.map(function(e){ return '<div class="good-tag">'+flabel(e.k)+'<span>'+fmtMsShort(e.avg)+' avg</span></div>'; }).join('')
    : '<span style="color:#7a8fb5;font-size:0.85rem;">Not enough data yet \u2014 keep playing!</span>';
    weakEl.innerHTML=weak.length
    ? weak.map(function(e){ return '<div class="slow-tag">'+flabel(e.k)+'<span>'+fmtMsShort(e.avg)+' avg</span></div>'; }).join('')
    : '<span style="color:#7a8fb5;font-size:0.85rem;">Not enough data yet \u2014 keep playing!</span>';
    wrongEl.innerHTML=mostWrong.length
    ? mostWrong.map(function(e){ return '<div class="slow-tag">'+flabel(e.k)+'<span>'+e.wrongCount+' wrong</span></div>'; }).join('')
    : '<span style="color:#7a8fb5;font-size:0.85rem;">No wrong answers recorded yet \u2014 nice!</span>';
    // Store worst 4 for the Practice button, and show/hide it
    var worst4=weak.slice(0,4).map(function(e){
    var parts=e.k.split('x'); return [parseInt(parts[0],10), parseInt(parts[1],10)];
    });
    window._worst4Facts=worst4;
    var pw4btn=document.getElementById('practiceWorst4Btn');
    pw4btn.style.display=worst4.length?'':'none';
    var sessions=ud.sessions||[];
    var ta=sessions.reduce(function(t,s){ return t+s.total; },0);
    var tc=sessions.reduce(function(t,s){ return t+s.correct; },0);
    var acc=ta>0?Math.round(tc/ta*100):0;
    var pCount=Object.keys(facts).filter(function(k){ return facts[k].count>0; }).length;
    var allBest=[];
    Object.keys(facts).forEach(function(k){ if(facts[k].best10&&facts[k].best10.length) allBest.push(facts[k].best10[0]); });
    var overallBest=allBest.length>0?Math.min.apply(null,allBest):0;
    document.getElementById('overallStats').innerHTML=
    '<span class="pill pill-gold">\uD83D\uDCDD '+sessions.length+' sessions</span>'+
    '<span class="pill pill-teal">\u2705 '+acc+'% accuracy</span>'+
    '<span class="pill pill-gold">\uD83D\uDD22 '+pCount+'/64 facts practiced</span>'+
    (overallBest>0?'<span class="pill pill-teal">\u26A1 Best ever: '+fmtMs(overallBest)+'</span>':'');
    }
    // ── Fact Map ────────────────────────────
    function renderFactMap(){
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey];
    var facts=ud&&ud.facts?ud.facts:{};
    var container=document.getElementById('factMapContent');
    // Build list of all 64 facts with their avg time
    var rows=ALL_FACTS.map(function(ab){
    var k=fkey(ab[0],ab[1]), f=facts[k];
    var avg=f&&f.count>0 ? f.totalMs/f.count : null;
    var count=f?f.count:0;
    return { ab:ab, k:k, avg:avg, count:count };
    });
    // Sort: practiced facts slowest first, then unseen
    var seen=rows.filter(function(r){ return r.avg!==null; }).sort(function(a,b){ return b.avg-a.avg; });
    var unseen=rows.filter(function(r){ return r.avg===null; });
    var sorted=seen.concat(unseen);
    // Max avg for bar scaling
    var maxAvg=seen.length>0?seen[0].avg:1;
    var html='<div class="fact-list">';
    sorted.forEach(function(r){
    var label=r.ab[0]+' \u00D7 '+r.ab[1]+' = '+r.ab[0]*r.ab[1];
    if(r.avg===null){
    html+='<div class="fact-row unseen">'+
    '<span class="fact-row-label">'+label+'</span>'+
    '<div class="fact-row-bar-wrap"><div class="fact-row-bar" style="width:0%;background:#3a4f6b;"></div></div>'+
    '<span class="fact-row-time" style="color:#3a4f6b;">not yet</span>'+
    '<span class="fact-row-count"></span>'+
    '</div>';
    } else {
    var pct=Math.max(4, Math.round((r.avg/maxAvg)*100));
    var color= r.avg<2000?'#06d6a0': r.avg<3000?'#118ab2': r.avg<5000?'#ffd166':'#ef476f';
    html+='<div class="fact-row">'+
    '<span class="fact-row-label">'+label+'</span>'+
    '<div class="fact-row-bar-wrap"><div class="fact-row-bar" style="width:'+pct+'%;background:'+color+';"></div></div>'+
    '<span class="fact-row-time" style="color:'+color+';">'+fmtMs(r.avg)+'</span>'+
    '<span class="fact-row-count">'+r.count+'x</span>'+
    '</div>';
    }
    });
    html+='</div>';
    container.innerHTML=html;
    }
    // ── Top 10 ────────────────────────────
    function renderTop10(){
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey];
    var facts=ud&&ud.facts?ud.facts:{};
    var container=document.getElementById('top10Content');
    // Only show facts that have at least one recorded time
    var entries=ALL_FACTS
    .map(function(ab){
    var k=fkey(ab[0],ab[1]), f=facts[k];
    return f&&f.best10&&f.best10.length ? { ab:ab, k:k, best10:f.best10 } : null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort(function(a,b){ return a.best10[0]-b.best10[0]; }); // sort by personal best
    if(!entries.length){ container.innerHTML='<div class="empty">No data yet \u2014 play some games first!</div>'; return; }
    // Global fastest across all facts (for bar scaling)
    var globalFastest=entries[0].best10[0];
    var html='';
    entries.forEach(function(e){
    var label=e.ab[0]+' \u00D7 '+e.ab[1]+' = '+e.ab[0]*e.ab[1];
    html+='<div class="fact-top10-block"><div class="fact-top10-title">'+label+'</div>';
    e.best10.forEach(function(ms, i){
    // Bar width: fastest time gets 100%, others proportionally shorter
    var barPct=Math.max(5, Math.round((globalFastest/ms)*100));
    var color= i===0?'#ffd166': i<3?'#06d6a0':'#118ab2';
    var rankStr= i===0?'\uD83E\uDD47': i===1?'\uD83E\uDD48': i===2?'\uD83E\uDD49': '#'+(i+1);
    html+='<div class="t10-row">'+
    '<span class="t10-rank">'+rankStr+'</span>'+
    '<div class="t10-bar-wrap"><div class="t10-bar" style="width:'+barPct+'%;background:'+color+';"></div></div>'+
    '<span class="t10-time" style="color:'+color+';">'+fmtMs(ms)+'</span>'+
    '</div>';
    });
    html+='</div>';
    });
    container.innerHTML=html;
    }
    // ── History ────────────────────────────
    function renderHistory(){
    var d=getData(), ud=d[userKey], el=document.getElementById('histTableContent');
    if(!ud||!ud.sessions||!ud.sessions.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="empty">No sessions yet \u2014 play a game first!</div>'; return; }
